name: ONLY EGGS NOW,
description: ONLY EGGS NOW, is a small pumpkin patch in Hallandale Beach, FL. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Oranges, and Tangerines, with picking through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
